gen-gf-lugrasimo-space-grotesk: Friendly and inviting, Lugrasimo writes with a hand-drawn looseness, its strokes never dropping to a hairline. And Space Grotesk draws every glyph with a flat, unvarying line, which makes a comfortable companion for a quick skim.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-amulya: Generous gaps in the curves give the body text a modern, open feel that never crowds. Amulya sits beneath Lumanosimo's casual, wire-steady handwriting, and the two work well for a quick burst of text.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-rowan: Lumanosimo writes in a casual, graceful hand with one unchanging stroke weight, while Rowan's serif strokes step softly from heavy to light. Across paragraphs Rowan feels literary and friendly, though brevity suits it better.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-spline-sans: Casual and graceful, Lumanosimo stretches its handwriting across open gaps in wire-thin strokes. Spline Sans sits below with wide curve openings and matching stroke weights, easy company for a quick look.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-synonym: Loose, wiry handwriting up top, drawn out across open gaps. Synonym keeps to a constant stripe of ink with generous openings, doing the dependable reading while Lumanosimo brings the charm.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-sora: Casual, graceful handwriting stretched across open gaps in wire-like strokes. Sora brings precise geometry, with no pressure swell at the corners and a sans-serif frame that stays easy to skim.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-plein: LXGW WenKai TC draws open-handed curves with an unvarying pen, while Plein keeps a clear channel into each round letter. Gentle, easygoing clarity carries the whole pair from heading to paragraph.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-rowan: LXGW WenKai TC bends thin steel-rod strokes into casual, graceful letters, while Rowan keeps a literary, friendly voice. Extended reading would go gently enough, though this pair prefers brevity.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-spline-sans: Wide gaps between curve ends and stems make the body text approachable and contemporary. Spline Sans keeps its strokes identical in weight while LXGW WenKai TC adds graceful, casual curves, a gentle pairing for a quick look.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-sora: A pen that never changes pressure or angle gives LXGW WenKai TC its open-handed curves, set against Sora's precise geometry. Page after page it would feel crisp, but short bursts suit it better.
